messages:
sam_sales: FYI — FinEdge (sales lead) just asked for a specific request: they want to pin `mistral-mini-v2` for EU customers, ensure EU-only hosting, and get an SLA for 99th p95 latency. Can we take this?

mira_pm: thanks. quick clarifying Qs — expected rps and peak qps? is this for Hosted or Dedicated? any compliance/KMS requirements?

sam_sales: they expect ~50 rps steady, 200 peak during batch jobs. Hosted preferred but must be EU region only; they're open to Dedicated if needed. Customer needs customer-managed keys (KMS) and retention logs for 1y. Priority: high (closed-won in pipeline).

dan_engineer: rough feasibility: `mistral-mini-v2` 8B in FP16 should run fine in eu-west-1 with autoscale, but pinned version + EU-only routing adds capacity reservation needs. For 200 qps peaks we need ~6-8 GPUs depending on batch & sequence length.

leo_solutions: workaround: we can initially route them to Hosted EU with a pinned model tag and soft capacity reservation, then propose Dedicated after first month. Also can set a geo-fallback policy to avoid cross-region egress.

mira_pm: launch criteria proposal: 1) capacity sizing verified on staging with 200 qps load test, 2) KMS integration validated, 3) telemetry + per-customer cost dashboard, 4) an ops playbook for failover to fallback model. Any objections?

nora_support: add logging + audit export checklist. Also need a runbook for data residency questions the compliance team will ask. I can draft.

dan_engineer: two engineering notes: - pinned model prevents automatic kernel/quant updates; we need a policy for security patches. - quant recommendation: try int8 dynamic as first pass to reduce GPU count.

leo_solutions: I'll prep a customer-facing proposal with phased roadmap (pilot on Hosted EU -> Dedicated commit if 30d usage > X) and estimated monthly cost bands.

mira_pm: triage decision: mark as P1 intake, owner = @mira_pm, engineering spike to confirm GPU footprint (Dan), KMS legal + support tasks (Nora). ETA for spike: EOD +2 (load test results).

sam_sales: noted, will escalate to account team and push timeline. Can we get a simple checklist to share?

mira_pm: checklist (pasteable):
```
- Confirm model artifact/version to pin (mistral-mini-v2 sha: TBD)
- Run load test: 200 qps sustained, measure p95 latency
- Validate KMS & EU-only networking
- Configure geo-routing + fallback policy
- Enable per-customer telemetry and cost dashboard
- Create ops runbook & compliance audit export
- Agree commercial terms for Dedicated if needed
```

capacity-bot: capacity alert: eu-west-1 GPUs at 78% util (estimate). Recommend reserve slot if final commit required.

mira_pm: thanks — Dan, can you run the spike and post results here? Nora will start a runbook draft. I'll convert this to a backlog ticket with acceptance criteria after the spike.

dan_engineer: taking the spike. I'll post perf numbers + recommended GPU count by EOD +2.

sam_sales: great, thanks all :thumbsup:
